notes.title: Aimtastic Build 141: Biggest Update To Date + DLC Launch
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

This is the largest update for the game so far, doubling the amount of playable game modes from 11 to 22, I won’t go into detail on every mode here, but you can get a brief overview in this trailer. And to celebrate the DLC is on sale now, so get it while it's cheap.

[previewyoutube=MOH5wcWqw6s;full][/previewyoutube]


This update also contains a full graphics rework, and visual customization is in the works, allowing you greater freedom in how your game looks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31727798/86228560a39267b3f436b4d91497b83716dc274c.png[/img]




When selecting a mode, you can now hover your mouse over the game mode in question to see a small preview, the update will also allow you to filter out game modes, allowing you to easily find the one you want.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31727798/bf70f01130e87d5bc85f46ba4d025d82337f87d3.png[/img]


The update also adds a new feature that allows you to easily convert your Aimtastic sensitivity to and from different games. You can also set it to cm/360 should you wish to.
Support for Rainbow 6: Siege sensitivity has been added.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31727798/71fac6415794f3811b4842889985be9fa863a8b5.png[/img]

[h2]FAQ:[/h2]
Q: Why are you so greedy and want money from us?
A: The money will allow me to work full time on the game, instead of just when I have spare time. So this will mean updates more often.
    All the money goes straight back into the game, to make it as good as possible.

Q: Will I have to pay for things that were free last patch?
A: No, everything that was free before is still free now. I also add new free things from time to time.

Q: I don't like this/I want this.
A: The community involvement is a big part of this game, I try to add in suggestions whenever possible.
    The best way of getting your feedback through is either on Discord or in the Steam Discussions.


Make sure to visit us on Discord. [url=https://discord.gg/j6qhUUH]https://discord.gg/j6qhUUH[/url]
